QuestInfo.name: [Spiegelmann's Lucky Boxes] 9 Lucky Boxes
QuestInfo.0:
#e#b<Spiegelmann's Lucky Boxes>#k#n



#e[Event Period]#n

1/27/2021 12:00 AM - 2/9/2021 11:59 PM UTC



#e[Event Details]#n
Spiegelmann, who hasn't been around in a while, suddenly showed up with a bunch of boxes. He says he found them while cleaning, and wants to distribute them to the heroes of Maple World.  
Though he also says he can't remember exactly what's inside them...
Since he can't give them to just any hero, he says he'll give a random box, daily, to each hero who hunts at least 2,000 monsters that day.
